assets.name: repair-editorial
assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: original illustrative editorial photograph for AFTERFORM, a fictional garment-repair studio portfolio. This is a styled conceptual illustration, not documentation of a real repair.
Primary request: landscape 3:2 high-end still-life fashion editorial photograph of a softly folded ivory cotton work shirt with one carefully executed contrasting vermilion repair patch near a worn elbow.
Scene/backdrop: matte pale-lilac studio surface with a restrained plum fabric edge in the composition.
Materials/textures: natural tactile cotton weave, realistic small stitches, gentle wear, beautiful material relationships and visibly human craft.
Composition/framing: elevated close three-quarter crop, controlled negative space; the red repair patch and folds read clearly.
Lighting/mood: soft directional daylight, quiet premium editorial art direction.
Constraints: no tools as decoration, no people, no hands, no logos, no words, no watermark; no hyper-smooth AI gloss. Original imagery, no copied reference artwork. Landscape 3:2.
assets.visual_review: No obvious generation defects. Vermilion reads as muted rust red; composition leaves modest negative space. Small stitches and cotton weave are visible.

assets.name: denim-detail
assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: original illustrative editorial photograph for AFTERFORM, a fictional garment-repair studio portfolio. This is a styled conceptual illustration, not documentation of a real repair.
Primary request: square extreme editorial close-up of indigo denim repaired with a controlled lilac darning rectangle; several precise parallel lilac threads visibly reinforce the original cloth.
Composition/framing: cropped garment seam and authentic denim fabric texture, the controlled rectangular repair clearly visible, shallow but usable depth of field.
Lighting/mood: naturally lit, quiet premium fashion art direction.
Materials/textures: authentic indigo denim weave and physically plausible lilac darning thread, visible natural fibers and small human variations in the craft.
Constraints: no text, logos, watermarks, hands, people or unrelated objects. Original imagery, no copied reference artwork. Square 1:1.
assets.visual_review: No text or unrelated objects. Darning reads as thick parallel lilac handwork with some irregular edge loops; these remain illustrative, not technical documentation.
